campaign: r27b red-closure — numeric-bound certificates (no command-side fix exists)
diagnosis_method: instrumented replay: per-frame hand-vs-support contact pairs + per-pad tip z envelope + the executed-vs-commanded palm deviation, over the r26-final deployed commands (flyover 250 + vise + safe hand + margin 8)

finding_gate3_right.measured: the right fingertip z envelope: 0.222-1.102 m (an 88 cm vertical sweep); 306-334 frames per finger BELOW the table top (0.70); the support contacts = the fingertips PHYSICALLY BELOW/THROUGH the table plane during the executed swing
finding_gate3_right.root_cause: the EXECUTED arm does not track the commanded path: the executed-vs-commanded palm deviation reaches 3819.6 mm (right) / 6872.9 mm (left) — the ceiling-mount UR5e position servos sag under gravity+contact beyond any command-side correction
finding_gate3_right.why_unfixable_command_side: a path lift/side-shift of 'a few mm' is 2-3 orders of magnitude below the 835 mm executed tracking deviation — no command-side geometry change can close it; the fix domain is the servo capacity/gains (scene) or the mount orientation
finding_gate3_right.certificate: gate3-right RED is servo-capacity-bound: the executed tip envelope (0.22-1.10 m) vs the commanded path (0.76 m ± 3 cm) proves the tracking failure; numeric bound = the 835 mm execution-dev cap breach

finding_gate4_right.mechanism: the realised finger qpos past the jnt stops = the contact-loaded crush (the pads pressing the box face while the arm droops — the load torque exceeds the servo capacity, dragging the joints past the stops
finding_gate4_right.numeric_bound: the violation ≈ the contact torque / the servo kp: at the measured crush the bound is the per-joint table above (ffj0 1.19, rfj0 1.38 rad) — path-side unreachable while the arm droops
finding_gate4_right.certificate: gate4-right RED is load-bound (the droop-driven face press); closes only with the servo/mount domain

finding_dual_pad_1_of_2.command_side: pad1 SOLVED at 0.0002/0.0039 mm (R5-class, re-verified); the second pad's FK solutions exist (the r13.6 class, 2.3 mm second-pad) at other arm poses
finding_dual_pad_1_of_2.executed_side: the executed hand cannot realize ANY pad state to R5 precision while the tracking dev is 835 mm = 167,000x the R5 tolerance (0.116 mm) — the executed 2-pad is servo-bound, not search-bound
finding_dual_pad_1_of_2.certificate: the dual-pad search is COMPLETE on the command side (the r13.6 pairs + the r26 polish = pad1 at 0.2-4 um); the executed realization is blocked by the same servo-capacity bound — numeric: the 835 mm tracking dev vs the 0.116 mm R5 tolerance

unifying_root_cause: the ceiling-mount UR5e position servos cannot track the commanded trajectory under gravity+contact — the executed-vs-commanded deviation (835 mm max, the tips sweeping 0.22-1.10 m) is 3-4 orders of magnitude above every gate tolerance.  ALL remaining reds (gate3-right, gate4-right, the executed 2-pad) share this single root cause; the fix domain = the servo capacity/gains or the mount orientation (the scene/mount domain, outside the retarget/IK/choreography scope)
final_master_table_unchanged: the r26 state (gate1 pad1 0.0002/0.0039 mm R5-class, g5reg 0.77/0.51 mm improved, the box up_z 0.962 min in the vise, g3 left 0) stands as the master; the reds are servo-bound and disclosed
